# r3 — Comprehensible

## What this measures

Once an agent reaches a product page, can it *understand* what is for sale?
Structured data is the difference between an agent quoting your real price
and guessing from prose. The probe finds a product URL via the sitemap and
reads its `application/ld+json`.

Both `Product` and `ProductGroup` (the variant-aware type — offers nested
under `hasVariant`) pass; agents consume either.

## Sub-checks

| Sub-check | Pass when | Weight | Fix skill |
|-----------|-----------|-------:|-----------|
| product URL discoverable | sitemap contains a `/product|/p|/item` leaf URL | 1 | — |
| Product/ProductGroup JSON-LD | PDP serves an `application/ld+json` object of that type | 2 | `nlweb-protocol:nlweb-schema-org-grounding` |
| Offer present | an `offers` object on the product or a variant | 1 | — |
| price + priceCurrency | Offer declares both | 2 | — |
| availability | Offer declares `availability` | 1 | — |

## N/A condition

The site sells nothing — no product URLs exist anywhere.

## Fix guidance

Emit Product JSON-LD server-side on every PDP (it must be in the HTML an
agent fetches, not injected by client JS). Platform skills that cover this:
`shopify-commerce:shopify-themes`, `woocommerce-commerce:woo-catalog`,
`magento2-commerce:magento-catalog`, `bigcommerce-commerce:bc-catalog`.
